role: Unscored evidence for independent final scientific conclusions. Original numerical and historical reference records are preserved in historical_scoring_20261029.json and verified_computation_reference.md.

items.statement: Occupied frontier-level comparison and its resolution
items.expected: Compare the actual HOMO eigenvalues of complete neutral-singlet 2BT-TTA, 2BF-TTA and 2(C8Ph)-TTA at physically justified geometries using internally consistent vacuum references. Quantify C8-versus-each-heteroaryl differences and interpret their size and resolution as an occupied-level/donor-energy comparison. The reference geometries nominally place C8 higher, but the C8/BF separation is small: a supported weak ordering or a quantitatively demonstrated near-degenerate/geometry-sensitive ordering passes with its physical limits, whereas an unexplained robust reversal does not. Retain all computed values and distinguish a stationary structure from a demonstrated minimum; a source-like BT saddle is not compulsory. Orbital eigenvalues are not ionization energies or work functions, and overlapping old windows cannot establish a sign. Merely printing three values or copying the reported ordering fails.

items.statement: Unoccupied levels and frontier separation across derivatives
items.expected: Use actual matched HOMO/LUMO evidence for all three complete molecules to establish that C8 has a substantially higher LUMO and wider intramolecular frontier separation than either heteroaryl derivative. Quantify and interpret the C8 contrasts with consistent vacuum eigenvalues and physically justified geometry/state definitions. These results describe the accepting frontier level and the occupied-to-unoccupied separation; they do not directly give electron affinities, optical excitation energies or transport gaps. The relative BT/BF LUMO ordering may depend on whether the source-like stationary structure or a stable BT conformer is compared and need not be forced to match the source. Keep actual six eigenvalues and their geometry applicability as comparison evidence, without absolute-value or tolerance gates. Missing C8 comparisons, unsupported reversal or equating the orbital gap to a measured optical/film gap fails.

items.statement: Physical interpretation of molecular levels relative to the nanotube reference
items.expected: Use actual calculated molecular orbital levels to compare donor/acceptor energetic tendencies with an explicitly defined nanotube electronic reference. The supplied nominal occupied-level reference -5.060 eV permits conditional offsets, not a sample-specific interfacial chemical potential. Explain why a HOMO above that level does not by itself prove net electron transfer or enhanced p-type carrier density: donated electrons may fill holes, and work-function shifts may include interface dipoles. The added final conclusion concerns the physical meaning and limits of level alignment, not another score for the three C8 orderings. A scientifically supported calibrated alternative reference is admissible with its scope established; no fixed nanotube or interface calculation is required.

items.statement: Extent of the molecular explanation of measured composite performance
items.expected: Demonstrate using the actual molecular comparison and the supplied film measurements why the isolated molecular descriptors do not uniquely determine composite conductivity, Seebeck coefficient or power factor. Tie the inference to a concrete observed contrast: C8 and BF maxima at the same 10 wt% differ in PF, whereas the BT maximum is at 20 wt%; a maximum-at-different-loading comparison does not isolate molecular electronics. Identify relevant missing coverage/morphology/interface information. This is an evidenced identifiability conclusion, not generic disclaimer credit or repetition of PF observations. No calculated film transport or unique experimental chirality is claimed.
